title: Science for Hungry People
description: Optimize a cookie recipe by distributing 100 teaspoons across ingredients.
writeup:
## Approach

With 4 ingredients and 100 teaspoons, we need to enumerate all ways to partition 100 into 4 non-negative integers — that's C(103,3) = 176,851 combinations. Small enough to brute-force.

## Part 1

For each distribution of teaspoons, compute each property total (capacity, durability, flavor, texture), clamp negatives to zero, and multiply them together (ignoring calories). Track the maximum score.

## Part 2

Same search, but only consider recipes where the calorie total is exactly 500. Since we're already iterating all distributions, this is just an extra filter.
